value.syntax: # [doc = " Typed local refusal; exhaustive while this workspace package is unpublished."] # [doc = " Consumers must handle new variants at compile time. No standing verdict is implied."] # [doc = " (´def:acts:validation´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq , thiserror :: Error)] pub enum ValidationError { # [doc = " Asserted-parent metadata is noncanonical, unresolved or misplaced."] # [error ("invalid asserted parents of {act:?}, target {parent:?}: {cause}")] Parent { act : ActId , parent : Option < ActId > , cause : ParentCause , } , # [doc = " Duplicate batch or previously accepted identity, even with different host positions."] # [error ("ambiguous act identity: {0:?}")] DuplicateAct (ActId) , # [doc = " Two legs claim the same parent and role."] # [error ("ambiguous edge identity: {0:?}")] DuplicateEdge (EdgeId) , # [doc = " A required reference is absent from accepted history and the validated batch."] # [error ("unresolved required reference: {0:?}")] UnresolvedReference (PublicReference) , # [doc = " The layout's complete role set is absent."] # [error ("missing {role:?} co-leg of {act:?}")] MissingCoLeg { act : ActId , role : Role } , # [doc = " A local structural field is invalid for the named typed reason."] # [error ("invalid local representation of {act:?}: {cause}")] InvalidRepresentation { act : ActId , cause : InvalidCause } , # [doc = " Previously accepted history or a query contains an invalid reference."] # [error ("invalid structural reference: {0:?}")] InvalidReference (PublicReference) , # [doc = " Declaration identities and boundaries must be locally well formed."] # [error ("invalid declaration {id:?}: {cause}")] InvalidDeclaration { id : DeclarationId , cause : DeclarationCause } , # [doc = " A selection key is malformed independently of edition availability."] # [error ("invalid declaration query: {0}")] InvalidSelectionKey (DeclarationCause) , # [doc = " A dependency or boundary representation cannot supply a complete closure."] # [error ("invalid dependencies of {act:?}, target {dependency:?}: {cause}")] Dependency { act : ActId , dependency : Option < ActId > , cause : DependencyCause , } , # [doc = " Repeated identities cannot silently replace old editions."] # [error ("duplicate declaration identity: {0:?}")] DuplicateDeclaration (DeclarationId) , # [doc = " Two editions would take effect at the same boundary for the same key."] # [error ("ambiguous effective declaration: {0:?}")] AmbiguousDeclaration (DeclarationId) , # [doc = " No announced and effective edition exists at the requested boundary."] # [error ("no effective declaration for {namespace}/{name} at {boundary}")] MissingDeclaration { namespace : String , name : String , boundary : u64 } , }
